questions.stem: Among the following options, Pitolisant is used in treatment in which condition?
questions.solutionHtml:
Narcolepsy
  • Narcolepsy is a long-term neurological disorder that involves a decreased ability to regulate sleep-wake cycles. Symptoms often include periods of excessive daytime sleepiness and brief involuntary sleep episodes. About 70% of those affected also experience episodes of sudden loss of muscle strength, known as cataplexy.


Lange Katzung's Basic and Clinical Pharmacology- 15th Edition/chapter 16/ Page Number: 4/35

questions.stem: Among the following options, which one is the Drug having Anti PAF activity?
questions.solutionHtml:
Rupatidine
  • Rupatadine fumarate has been approved for the treatment of allergic rhinitis and chronic urticaria in adults and children over 12 years. It is available as round, light salmon-coloured tablets containing 10 mg of rupatadine (as fumarate) to be administered orally, once a day.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:182

questions.stem: Among the following options, which one is a 5HT1A agonist used in anxiety?
questions.solutionHtml:
Buspirone
  • Buspirone decreases some of the activity of a chemical called serotonin in the brain. This decrease is thought to affect anxiety. Buspirone oral tablet causes drowsiness.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 187

questions.stem: Among the following triptans, longest acting triptan is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Frovatriptan
  • rizatriptan is the fastest acting and frovatriptan is the longest-acting in the group
  • Selective 5-HT1D/1B agonists (Triptans)
  • This novel class of antimigraine drugs selectively activate 5-HT1D/1B receptors, and are called ‘triptans’. Currently, they are the first-line drugs for patients who fail to respond to analgesics.
  • Ergot alkaloids are now required only in a few cases.
  • Because these drugs have been designed to act on the same subtype of the 5-HT receptor, pharmacodynamic differences among them are minor, but there are significant pharmacokinetic differences.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 193,194

questions.stem: A 36-year male has been found to have pulmonary fibrosis in the chest x-ray when he did his regular health check-up. His medication history shows that he is under migraine prophylaxis. Which medication would be responsible for his chest X-ray finding?
questions.solutionHtml:
Methysergide
  • Methysergide: is used for the prophylactic treatment of migraine and other vascular headaches. A serious complication of prolonged treatment is inflammatory fibrosis.


Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics 13th Edition Page No. 232-234.

questions.stem: A patient has been prescribed Erenumab for migraine prophylaxis. According to which of the following mechanisms will it act?
questions.solutionHtml:
CGRP receptor antagonism
  • Erenumab is a recently approved monoclonal antibody that acts by CGRP receptor antagonism and reduces the number of migraine attacks.


Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi 8th Edition Page No. 193-195.

questions.stem: A 31-year-old female came with complaints of decreased libido and sexual fear. Which of the following drugs can be prescribed to her?
questions.solutionHtml:
Flibanserin
  • Flibanserin is a 5HT1A agonist and 5HT2 antagonist. It is recently approved to treat hypoactive sexual desire disorder (HSDD) in premenopausal women. It enhances sexual function by decreasing 5HT levels in the cortex.


Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics 13th Edition Page No. 230,234. , Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi 8th Edition Page No. 724.

questions.stem: A mother of a 6-year-old boy came to the pediatric department and complained about her son that he is a poor eater and there has been no increase in weight for the past few months. The paediatrician prescribed the boy Cyproheptadine syrup. This drug is known to act on the following receptors except:
questions.solutionHtml:
Beta-adrenergic receptors
  • Beta-adrenergic receptors: The adrenergic receptors or adrenoceptors are a class of G protein-coupled receptors that are targets of many catecholamines like norepinephrine (noradrenaline) and epinephrine (adrenaline) produced by the body, but also many medications like beta blockers, beta-2 (β2) agonists and alpha-2 (α2) agonists, which are used to treat high blood pressure and asthma.
  • Option: A. Cyproheptadine has no additional action on beta-adrenergic


Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi 8th Edition Page No. 189.

questions.stem: A 29-year-old male came has been treated for an acute attack of migraine in the general medicine department. After that, he has prescribed an autoinjector with a drug that he should inject himself when a similar acute attack occurs in the future. Which drug will be present in the autoinjector?
questions.solutionHtml:
Sumatriptan
  • Sumatriptan: is a medication used to treat migraine headaches and cluster headaches. It is taken orally, intranasally, or by subcutaneous injection. Therapeutic effects generally occur within three hours.


Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics 13th Edition Page No. 232

questions.stem: A 26-year-old female is diagnosed with postpartum haemorrhage in the labour ward. Which of the ergot alkaloids should be prescribed to her?
questions.solutionHtml:
Ergometrine
  • Ergometrine The primary indication for ergometrine/ methylergometrine is to control and prevent postpartum haemorrhage (PPH): 0.2–0.3 mg i.m. at delivery of anterior shoulder reduces blood loss attending delivery and prevents PPH.


Essentials of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi 8th Edition Page No. 191, 357.& Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics 13th Edition Page No. 234.

questions.stem: A pregnant woman came with complaints from which you have diagnosed that she is suffering from an acute attack of migraine. You have decided to administer triptan considering her symptoms and risk to the fetus. Which triptan is considered safe during pregnancy?
questions.solutionHtml:
Sumatriptan
  • The triptans are pregnancy category C drugs (i.e., there are no adequate and well-controlled studies in pregnant women; use during pregnancy only if the potential benefit justifies a potential risk to the fetus) and should also be used with caution in nursing mothers


Goodman & Gilman’s The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics 13th Edition Page No. 233.
